name: 沧月星澜
overview: After being transported into a game world, Cang Yue is tasked with uncovering the truth behind the destruction of the Moon Hidden Clan if she ever hopes to return to reality. Disguised within the Donglin royal court, she pursues a path of revenge only to discover a far-reaching conspiracy involving a puppet emperor and a power-hungry grand princess. With the help of unexpected allies, Cang Yue must expose the truth and complete her mission before she can return home.
